reviewScope: Original question and explanation, supporting source, choice plausibility, honest difficulty, related facts in 20,100 live questions and the staged set. Similarity tools were editorial aids, not automatic acceptance.
revisions: Removed answer-giving phrases and implausible alternatives.
Retargeted questions that tested ordinary facts instead of the unusual part.
Removed unnecessary answer articles where they interfered with starts-with-letter play; preserved real titles.
Shuffled answer positions, with totals of 72, 78, 84 and 76 across the four positions.
Repaired confirmed broken source links and replaced inferred paths with exact sources.
